day_summary: BTC closed the June 20 UTC day at $64,293.99 (Crypto.com MCP, June 21 00:00 UTC candle) — the THIRD consecutive UTC daily close above the $63,500 stop level. The stop framework is now STABLE. The UTC close of $64,293.99 represents a gain of +$749.56 (+1.18%) from the June 19 UTC close of $63,544.43. The intraday dip to $63,178.28 (which breached the stop level) was absorbed decisively — the recovery from $63,178 to $64,294 (+$1,115) confirms the $63,000–$63,500 zone has strong demand. Live price at 01:03 UTC June 21: $64,307.80 (+1.24% from June 19 UTC close, based on MCP ticker). The June 22 US session remains the critical conviction event: IBIT ETF flow confirmation (need second consecutive net inflow day) and DXY gate (<100) are the two conditions required to upgrade conviction and add to position.
